ideas.name: any warning the day after a wide day
ideas.why: volatility clusters, and the day after a wide one is spent digesting it: two-way trade where turns pay

ideas.name: any warning after the day's last flip failed
ideas.why: a box flip that lost its race means today's moves are not following through: a choppy day where warnings (turns) pay

ideas.name: any warning after a wide overnight
ideas.why: an overnight range over half the usual day's range has done the day's discovery early, so RTH trades inside it two ways

ideas.name: any warning against a multi-day stretch
ideas.why: price over 1.5 days' ranges from its 20-settlement average is stretched at the daily scale; intraday turns back toward it have swing traders taking profit behind them

ideas.name: any warning on a heavy-volume bar
ideas.why: a warning on a bar trading over twice the usual volume for that minute is a climax: the last forced orders the old way meeting the new side
